items.description: This list covers natural language processing — linguistic analysis, multilingual tooling, classical and neural methods, datasets, and evaluation. Large language models are included only where they advance or evaluate a core NLP task or capability (tokenization, multilinguality, MT, summarization, NER, QA, factuality, probing, distillation). General-purpose chatbots, agent frameworks, prompt-template repositories, code-generation tools, and RAG application starter kits live in other lists — see See Also.
